text: Suit cuffs pinched my wrists from a long day at work. A deep ache, originating at the base of my tail, ascended each floor of my spine to the tufts of my ears.
But as I passed the threshold into the dizzying world of pachinko, none of that mattered anymore.
I had earned this break. I deserved a bit of fun, didn’t I?

name: Maneki
text: W-wow...! I can't believe how many games there are.

name: Old Woman
text: Heh. Never been to pachinko before, have you?

name: Maneki
text: Are you the manager? How do I play?

name: Bum
text: Nooooo! That was my entire salary, dammit! Guess it’s time to sell the house and divorce my wife. Hell, I’ll sell the kittens, too.

name: Old Woman
text: Don’t pay him any mind. If you’re a lucky cat like me, then you have nothing to fear.

name: Bum
text: I heard that, you heartless feline! I may not have found the secret yet, but I know you’re cheating somehow.

name: Old Woman
text: So, you don’t know how to play. Here. Have a go at my favorite game.
The old woman handed me a cup full of steel balls.
I sat down at the machine and loaded the balls into the slot.
